mintAuthority.summary: Native issuance remains under issuer authority. ZARU has a System Program Solana signer and the same EOA with mint/admin/upgrader powers on three EVM chains.

controls.label: Solana Token-2022 mint authority
controls.evidence: Finalized mint at slot 452860530 retains the sole mintAuthority 8USLqNrJ6WfUcTk2XUBYGRiMA2Mp2qh9AhsJZBEg5W62. At slot 452861255 that authority is a nonexecutable zero-data System Program account, not an SPL multisig or PDA; no code-enforced quorum or delay is demonstrated. Token-2022 native minting has no issuer-authored quantitative supply-cap parameter to raise. Creation transaction 5ujgjg4P8ciRqDaQkMjM135KoWkMJUmRbxXj5nQUdxkEhkMFrx8rFDnaqCtU27Vv8RtkbbRP2Xmay41pMBJUJNW9 creates and initializes this exact mint at slot 373091718 on 2025-10-13; that is deployment age, not public distribution age.

controls.label: ethereum MINTER_ROLE and role administrator
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26110191, additionally verified BURNER_ROLE, CONTRACT_ADMIN_ROLE and SALVAGE_ROLE are true for this EOA. Full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history through block 26110183 returned eight grants to this sole address and no revocations, covering DEFAULT_ADMIN, MINTER, PAUSER, RECOVERY, BURNER, CONTRACT_ADMIN, SALVAGE and UPGRADER. Verified ERC20F source gates mint only by MINTER_ROLE, with no quantitative cap; _authorizeUpgrade is immediate UPGRADER_ROLE. accessRegistry() is 0xfa51dd24f7348d5f0e6c5a5a00213d85ca401da9. Role administration and upgrades can expand issuance, without independently established human quorum or HSM custody.

controls.label: base MINTER_ROLE and role administrator
controls.evidence: Full Base RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history through block 52110948 returned eight grants to this sole EOA and no revocations, including BURNER_ROLE, CONTRACT_ADMIN_ROLE and SALVAGE_ROLE as well as DEFAULT_ADMIN, MINTER, UPGRADER, RECOVERY and PAUSER. Current BURNER and CONTRACT_ADMIN membership was independently confirmed at the pin; SALVAGE's full-history grant was observed but a fresh membership call was rate-limited. Verified ERC20F source has immediate role-gated mint and UUPS upgrades, with no numeric cap. accessRegistry() at block 52110830 is 0xfa51dd24f7348d5f0e6c5a5a00213d85ca401da9. No signer-independence or HSM attestation is inferred.

controls.label: arc MINTER_ROLE and role administrator
controls.evidence: At Arc block 24011807, additionally verified BURNER_ROLE, CONTRACT_ADMIN_ROLE and SALVAGE_ROLE are true for the previously observed DEFAULT_ADMIN/MINTER/UPGRADER/RECOVERY/PAUSER EOA. Verified ERC20F source gates mint only by MINTER_ROLE and UUPS upgrades only by UPGRADER_ROLE, with no numeric cap or mandatory delay. accessRegistry() is 0xfa51dd24f7348d5f0e6c5a5a00213d85ca401da9. Full Arc role-event enumeration did not complete: the RPC rejected both the full-history request and 100,000-block chunks, so additional role holders remain an explicit coverage gap.

review.evidence: Solana mint authority and Ethereum/Base complete role event inventories were independently pinned on 2026-10-03; Arc additionally exposes BURNER, CONTRACT_ADMIN and SALVAGE membership for the known EOA, but the full Arc census remains incomplete after RPC range rejection. Verified native mint/admin/UUPS paths are economically unbounded and immediately executable; no HSM or independent human quorum is asserted. Canonical Solana mint creation was confirmed at slot 373091718 on 2025-10-13. The July snapshot reconciles historical circulation to reserves, but no recurring current financial reconciliation was retrieved. Whitepaper 4.04/4.08 discloses mint-after-validated-rand-deposit and burn on redemption; transaction-level deposit validation is not itself a disclosed recurring issuer-ledger reconciliation cadence, so reconciliation remains unknown. The report was signed August 28; current reserve weights are not established. ISRS 4400 AUP provides no assurance opinion; legal insolvency priority and MMF look-through/duration remain unproved. Independent operators and HSM/key-custody arrangements for the identified issuance keys remain unverified. Partner minimums, fees and capacity are unquantified; CEX volume is not DEX depth. Only about seven days of the requested 90-day price history were retrieved, so no FX-normalized depeg assertion is supported. Provider circulation provenance is retained: native deployment stocks are not independently reconciled legal total liabilities or a justified aggregate override. FSP55172 remains issuer-claimed, without independently pinned regulator authorization. These key-custody, Backing, exit, market-data and supervision qualifications do not replace the retained Arc census question. Additional runtime-identity proof on 2026-10-03: eth_getCode for implementation 0x0f25045d15c163478bb67c56c5d9d602628f4f62 at Base block 52110948 and Arc block 24011807 is byte-for-byte equal to the Ethereum current ERC20F reference. Ethereum Blockscout reports is_verified=true and its deployed_bytecode equals that same RPC runtime. All three are 15,673 bytes with SHA-256 67b5282aa52d48b0156e2feb617b49bd2b2c4cd7fd3b98017c70533bcbeaa64d. This closes cross-chain deployed-bytecode equality only: Blockscout reports is_fully_verified=false and is_partially_verified=true, while Sourcify runtimeMatch=match rather than exact_match. Full compiler source/runtime correspondence remains qualified alongside the separate missing Arc role-holder census.

unresolvedQuestions: Full Arc role-holder enumeration remains incomplete after public RPC range rejection; the complete issuance and upgrade authority census on this native deployment is not established.

The shared ERC20F mint/UUPS implementation has partial compiler verification only (Blockscout is_fully_verified=false/is_partially_verified=true; Sourcify runtimeMatch=match). Exact cross-chain runtime equality is proven, but equality to a fully verified reference and complete compiler source/runtime correspondence have not been independently established.
